allowlist.purpose: Publish the folded single-tick capacity of the reviewed route so the review gate can prove the final input amount still fits inside the tick range of every hop.
Record the hop whose folded capacity is the smallest, so the review record names the pool that binds the route.
Carry the per-hop tick-range price limit the review proved, so the executor never falls back to a global price bound.
Carry the reviewed single-tick bound into the broadcast request so the executor refuses a payload larger than the reviewed capacity.
Carry the binding pool of the reviewed single-tick bound into the broadcast request.
Carry the reviewed per-hop price limits into the broadcast request so the swap calldata is built from the proven limits.
Keep the reviewed single-tick bound on the last durable attempt row, so an operator can prove after the fact that the broadcast amount was inside the reviewed capacity.
Keep the binding pool of the reviewed single-tick bound on the attempt row.
Keep the reviewed per-hop price limits on the attempt row so the broadcast can be audited against the proven limits.
Publish whether the reviewed route matched the closed-loop catalog the closed-loop Manager owns, so a consumer of the review record never has to re-derive the identity outside the Manager.
Publish whether every pool the reviewed route priced is a pool the closed-loop Manager published for that hop, so a pool-identity failure is distinguishable from a missing loop.
Carry the diagnosis of an identity mismatch on the review record, naming the pool that broke the match.
Carry the repair target the identity mismatch names on the review record, so the repair reads the target from the Manager instead of recomputing it.

description: AC-141 registry. Every column that the manager_db migrations add to a review / submission / broadcast table must be listed here together with the review record that proves the field supports the token/pool base structure. A new column without a registry entry is rejected by flashloan/app_runtime/tests/unit/test_architecture_guards.py::test_review_submission_broadcast_schema_extensions_are_registered.
